Gerrit 3218 amended: `dead0ca8188e` to `3401b613dd2`, Change-Id `I2c6d122c5b4e261cda53982f7dae1148b05e4990` preserved via `git commit --amend --no-edit`.

## Why it was amended rather than submitted as-is

The previous patch set was fully green (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved) and submittable, so re-pushing costs a full vote round trip. It was still the right call, for a reason that only became visible while implementing e095.

3218 adds the `build-vectors` **store route** to `STORE_ROUTES` but adds no row for it to the per-command table in `docs/exit-codes.md`. That was harmless while the parity test in `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_exit_codes.py` keyed each doc row on its first token only — a `store` row matched the live `store` route regardless of member. e095 removes exactly that blind spot: it unions `STORE_ROUTES` into the live set as `store <name>`, so a live store member with no row fails the build.

Measured, not inferred: `origin/main` contains 0 occurrences of `store build-vectors` in `docs/exit-codes.md`, and `git show HEAD -- docs/exit-codes.md` on the old patch set added no such row. So submitting 3218 unamended would have planted a failure that e095 detonates on landing.

## What the amendment added

Three advisory LLM-Review fixes, all previously uncommitted in the worktree:

- `docs/exit-codes.md` — the `store build-vectors` row, documenting that exit **0** covers the no-`[llm] embedding_model` case (declining to opt in is not an error), **1** means the build was entered and could not run (provider unreachable, index unopenable), and bad args give **2**.
- `tests/unit/test_similar_build_cli.py` — 2 added tests (+44 lines).

Gated before amending: `ruff check` clean, `ruff format --check` clean, `pytest tests/unit/test_similar_build_cli.py` 12 passed. `rebar verify-commit-ticket --rev HEAD` resolves 0461-09ce-4850-42a7.

`make verify` then push to Gerrit follows. It is queued behind another run on this host, which is at load average 57 from unrelated processes, so the usual 25-30 minute figure is running closer to 80.
